insights.one_liner: Refresco is a Rotterdam-based drinks maker that bottles soft drinks and juices for retailers and brands, and is a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Refresco fills soft drinks and juices for supermarkets and brands rather than selling its own big-name products.
It is a Dutch beverage manufacturer headquartered in Rotterdam, founded in 2000.

open.text: Three Refresco entities (Benelux, Europe and Holding B.V.) are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a legal/compliance internship in Rotterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: SunOpta, now part of Refresco, opened a $35M production line for plant-based dairy drinks.
SunOpta, now part of Refresco, is expanding production in Midlothian, Texas.
Its Carlisle site in the US stays open but with reduced staff and operations.

worth_knowing.text: Refresco named Minsok Pak, ex-CEO of CJ Foods, as President and Chief Strategy & Transformation Officer.
US grape growers were left stranded after Refresco cancelled contracts, and New York lawmakers sought a federal buyout for them.
Settlement information was published for a US case over Refresco Beverages job applications.
